children.name: Article Lead
children.text: Expose only the controls Gameplane can execute and observe reliably through console, logs, status, players, and providers.

children.name: Article Callout Text
children.text: Capability gates should hide unsupported controls instead of allowing an action that will predictably fail.

children.name: Section Body 1
children.text: Choose RCON or PTY, authoritative game logs, safe credentials, and bounded stop/quiesce hooks.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 0
children.text: Never hard-code a console password; authentication: false only for no-password consoles (v0.4.0).

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 1
children.text: Separate game log path from container stdout.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 2
children.text: Provide graceful stop and backup quiesce/unquiesce with timeouts.

children.name: Section Body 2
children.text: Use strict templates and defensive parsers for user actions, live status, players, and moderation.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 0
children.text: Declare parameters, validation, labels, icons, and gates; currentFrom pre-fills from live status (v0.3.0).

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 1
children.text: Degrade stale or unsupported status instead of fabricating values.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 2
children.text: Model kick, ban, whitelist, and other controls independently.

children.name: Section Body 3
children.text: Declare directories, install methods, IDs, compatibility, providers, restart behavior, and safe download/extraction rules.

children.name: Edit Page Body
children.text: Found a gap? Open a docs issue or suggest an edit on GitHub.
